convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorZerolagRVI custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position open/close logic and utility classes (CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, BuyPositionOpen, etc.)

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: long signal triggers SELL_Close when SellPosClose=true, short signal triggers BUY_Close when BuyPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT (fixed lots) and other margin modes; MM=0.1 with LOT mode means 0.1 lots fixed; with other modes it represents a fraction of margin/deposit

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses SignalBar=1 (previous bar) for crossover detection: compares Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (bar-1 relationship) with Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] (bar-0 relationship) to detect a crossover that occurred at bar SignalBar. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as feature toggles to enable/disable specific trade directions and close actions independently. The EA delegates all actual order placement/closure to TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) which may contain additional logic not visible here. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls bar-level signal gating. Recount flag triggers signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorZerolagRVI is a composite zero-lag RVI indicator with 5 weighted RVI components - this must be reimplemented in Python from scratch since it's a custom indicator with no standard equivalent. The 5 factors and RVI periods create a weighted sum: Factor1*RVI(period1) + Factor2*RVI(period2) + ... + Factor5*RVI(period5) with smoothing. The RVI (Relative Vigor Index) built-in must be replicated. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory) must be reimplemented. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes via MMMode enum which needs mapping. SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points and may need digit-adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers. Deviation=10 for slippage control must be handled in order submission.
